units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yoma 5:1:7">Y. Yoma V, 42ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>פְּשִׁיטַת יד</he> reaching out with the hand.

senses.gloss: undressing. Ib. III, 40ᶜ הקיש פ׳ ללבישה draw an analogy between (the high priest’s) taking off and (his) putting on his garments; Bab. ib. 31ᵇ; a. e.—V. לְבִישָׁה.
